title: Azahar 2125.0-rc4: official release candidate
summary: Azahar published 2125.0-rc4 on March 21, 2026. The release record documents an official release candidate for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2125.0-rc4 on March 21, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: Fixed game shortcuts opening correctly in the vanilla build. @OpenSauce04 1926.
